reason: Contains the FileViewer Spreadsheet Preview (CSV/XLSX/ODS) section + pnpm patch convention on @file-viewer/renderer-spreadsheet. Implementation must update this spec to reflect the in-house CSV renderer and the removal of the patch.
React component conventions for the new in-house CsvFileViewerPreview — file organization, prop types, render boundaries.
Hook patterns for papaparse memoization (useMemo on content), @tanstack/react-virtual useVirtualizer, clipboard routing hook, document-level copy event lifecycle in useEffect.
Convention for the '共 {rows} 行，{cols} 列' status line — placement, i18n key naming, message interpolation.

Tauri WKWebView clipboard quirks (B5/B6): navigator.clipboard.writeText fails, Cmd+C accelerator preempts keydown. Implementation must follow the established routing pattern through @tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager with textarea fallback.
